import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
class Screen extends StatefulWidget {
  const Screen({super.key});
  @override
  State<Screen> createState() => ScreenState();
}
mixin LifecycleEffects on State<Screen> {
  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    mixinDependency();
  }
}
class ScreenState extends State<Screen> with LifecycleEffects {
  @override
  void initState() { super.initState(); initDependency(); }
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => GestureDetector(
    onTap: onPressed,
    child: Text(buildDependency(), textDirection: TextDirection.ltr),
  );
  void onPressed() { callbackDependency(); }
  @override
  void dispose() { disposeDependency(); super.dispose(); }
  void unusedMember() { hiddenDependency(); }
}
void mixinDependency() {}
void callbackDependency() {}
void initDependency() {}
String buildDependency() => 'alive';
void disposeDependency() {}
void hiddenDependency() {}
class DeadScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const DeadScreen({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Text(deadBuildDependency(), textDirection: TextDirection.ltr);
}
String deadBuildDependency() => 'dead';
